import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from lightgbm import LGBMRegressor
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
from datetime import datetime
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Configure suppressions
os.environ["OMP_NUM_THREADS"] = "1"

# Load data from correct locations
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/labels.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Training data shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test data shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Parse pickup_datetime and create useful features
train_df["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(train_df["pickup_datetime"])
test_df["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(test_df["pickup_datetime"])

# Extract time features
train_df["hour"] = train_df["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
train_df["dayofweek"] = train_df["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
train_df["dayofmonth"] = train_df["pickup_datetime"].dt.day
train_df["month"] = train_df["pickup_datetime"].dt.month

test_df["hour"] = test_df["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
test_df["dayofweek"] = test_df["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
test_df["dayofmonth"] = test_df["pickup_datetime"].dt.day
test_df["month"] = test_df["pickup_datetime"].dt.month

train_df["is_weekend"] = ((train_df["pickup_datetime"].dt.weekday >= 5)).astype(int)
test_df["is_weekend"] = ((test_df["pickup_datetime"].dt.weekday >= 5)).astype(int)

train_df["is_night"] = ((train_df["hour"] > 17) | (train_df["hour"] < 6)).astype(int)
test_df["is_night"] = ((test_df["hour"] > 17) | (test_df["hour"] < 6)).astype(int)


# Calculate geographic distance
def calc_distance(pickup_lat, pickup_lon, dropoff_lat, dropoff_lon):
    return max(0, abs(dropoff_lat - pickup_lat) + abs(dropoff_lon - pickup_lon)) * 111


train_df["distance"] = train_df.apply(
    lambda x: calc_distance(
        x["pickup_latitude"],
        x["pickup_longitude"],
        x["dropoff_latitude"],
        x["dropoff_longitude"],
    ),
    axis=1,
)

test_df["distance"] = test_df.apply(
    lambda x: calc_distance(
        x["pickup_latitude"],
        x["pickup_longitude"],
        x["dropoff_latitude"],
        x["dropoff_longitude"],
    ),
    axis=1,
)

# Prepare features
feature_cols = [
    "pickup_latitude",
    "pickup_longitude",
    "dropoff_latitude",
    "dropoff_longitude",
    "passenger_count",
    "distance",
    "hour",
    "dayofweek",
    "dayofmonth",
    "month",
    "is_weekend",
    "is_night",
]

X_train_full = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
y_train = train_df["fare_amount"]
X_test = test_df[[c for c in feature_cols if c in test_df.columns]].copy()

# Fill missing values
X_train_full = X_train_full.fillna(X_train_full.median())
X_test = X_test.fillna(X_test.mean(axis=0))

# Properly split data - validation will NEVER be refitted after model training
# Use random_state for reproducibility
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42
)

# Create LightGBM model with appropriate parameters for this problem type
model = LGBMRegressor(
    n_estimators=300,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    max_depth=8,
    num_leaves=31,
    min_child_samples=20,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    random_state=42,
    verbosity=-1,  # Suppress output
)

# Train the model on ONLY the training split (not validation)
model.fit(
    X_train, y_train, eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)], verbose=False, early_stopping_rounds=50
)

# Predict on test set (never included in training or validation)
test_pred = model.predict(X_test)

# Generate submission file exactly in required format
submission_df = sample_submission.copy()
submission_df.loc[:, "fare_amount"] = test_pred.round(2)

# Sort by key to ensure consistent ordering
submission_df = submission_df.sort_values("key").reset_index(drop=True)

# Save to required path
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv ({len(submission_df)} rows)")

# Calculate and print validation RMSE (true hold-out evaluation)
val_rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_val, model.predict(X_val)))
print(f"Validation RMSE: {val_rmse:.4f} (hold-out estimate, never refitted)")
